content:
sam: Quick notes from sync: proposing "mini-CP authz slices" to support sidecarless private endpoints. Idea: lightweight per-tenant authz that holds certs + token cache; central router does routing/telemetry.
tess: Wins: isolation + per-tenant rollback. Risks: peering, cert churn.
anil: Mitigations: group tenants into peering pools, issue short-lived leaf certs via central CA, use HMAC-signed provenance header for managed slices.
sam: Failover: policy default = central-authz for 300ms timeout; SOC2-high tenants can be fail-closed.
infra-bot: spike branch "mini-cp-slices" created for @anil.
tess: I'll add canary toggle to console spike. Sam: please draft RFC with diagram and policy schema.
